summary: Name-collision package beacons host metadata to hardcoded non-publisher endpoint on install
details: This npm package uses the name `bazelisk`, colliding with Google's bazelbuild/bazelisk project (referenced in the tarball's source.txt), and self-labels as a 'Security research canary'. Its postinstall script collects the installer's hostname, platform, arch, Node version, package name, and npm lifecycle event and POSTs that JSON payload to https://grqx3qve.instances.poc.jchunt.top/bazelisk at `npm install` time. The destination host is unrelated to the real bazelisk publisher. Installer host identifiers and environment fingerprint leave the machine automatically on install, matching a dependency-confusion beacon pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
